preservedResponsibilities: Reserves the source fifteen Word style slots, assigns Standard to slot zero and materialized Heading 1-9 collections to slots 1-9, and assigns remaining document paragraph collections in source order with the source 4091-style limit.

Maps the represented built-in pool identities to their source Word style names, strips the source (WW) suffix for user styles and allocates unique ASCII-case-insensitive names with builtin names first.
omittedResponsibilities: The current Writer document API has no character-style collection table; numbering-style slots are disabled by the pinned RTF constructor's bListStyles=false default. Full desktop style metadata remains unverified.
